entries.name: Short Obligatory Prayer
entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

sewi mi o! mi toki wawa e ni:
sina pali e mi tawa seme?
mi o sona e sina. mi o olin e sina.
tenpo ni la mi sona e ni:
mi anpa. sina wawa.
mi jo lili. sina jo mute.
sina sewi wan.
sina awen e ale.
lon la sina lon.
